data.name: MenuAboutAppFormat

data.name: ActionActualSize
data.comment: Zoom back to 100%.

data.name: ActionAsciiOnly
data.comment: A check mark item: when on, the document holds only printable ASCII characters.

data.name: ActionFont
data.comment: Opens the font picker for the document.

data.name: ActionAllowTinyWindow
data.comment: Debug menu: lifts the window's minimum size until it closes, to test how the layout copes with little room.

data.name: ActionSampleWindow1
data.comment: Debug menu: opens or closes an empty window, to test stacks until there are more real windows.

data.name: ActionSampleWindow2
data.comment: Debug menu: opens or closes a second empty window.

data.name: ActionSampleWindow3
data.comment: Debug menu: opens or closes a third empty window.

data.name: ActionThrowTestException
data.comment: Debug builds only.

data.name: StatusZoomFormat
data.comment: {0} is the zoom as a percentage, for example 150.

data.name: StatusFrameRateFormat
data.comment: Debug frame-rate readout. {0} is the average frames a second over the last 2 seconds, {1} the average of the slowest 1% of frames, and {2} the most milliseconds the canvas spent drawing one frame.

data.name: StatusFrameRateIdle
data.comment: Debug frame-rate readout when the canvas hasn't redrawn lately, because nothing changed.

data.name: StatusCellFormat
data.comment: The cell under the pointer. {0} is the column and {1} the row, both counted from 0.

data.name: StatusCharacterSetUnicode
data.comment: Status bar: the document can hold any character.

data.name: StatusCharacterSetAscii
data.comment: Status bar: the document holds only printable ASCII characters.

data.name: StatusCanvasSizeFormat
data.comment: The canvas size. {0} is the width and {1} the height, in cells.

data.name: DefaultLayerName
data.comment: The name of a new document's first layer.

data.name: AboutVersionFormat
data.comment: {0} is the version, for example "0.1.0 (fc89da6)".

data.name: ToolEraser
data.comment: The Eraser group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: empties cells, backgrounds included. Key 1 chooses it while an eraser is chosen.

data.name: ToolSoftEraser
data.comment: The Eraser group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: lightens characters along the ramp. Key 2 chooses it while an eraser is chosen.

data.name: ToolBackgroundEraser
data.comment: The Eraser group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: erases backgrounds and leaves characters. Key 3 chooses it while an eraser is chosen.

data.name: ToolGroupEraser
data.comment: Tools toolbar: the Eraser group's button, which chooses the eraser used last. E chooses it too.

data.name: ToolRectangleSelect
data.comment: The Select group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: drag to select a rectangle of cells. Key 1 chooses it while a selection tool is chosen.

data.name: ToolEllipseSelect
data.comment: The Select group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: drag to select an ellipse of cells. Key 2 chooses it while a selection tool is chosen.

data.name: ToolLasso
data.comment: The Select group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: drag around the cells to select. Key 3 chooses it while a selection tool is chosen.

data.name: ToolPolygonalLasso
data.comment: The Select group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: click corner after corner of a shape to select. Key 4 chooses it while a selection tool is chosen.

data.name: ToolMagicWand
data.comment: The Select group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: click a cell to select the cells that match it. W chooses it, and so does key 5 while a selection tool is chosen.

data.name: ToolGroupSelect
data.comment: Tools toolbar: the Select group's button, which chooses the selection tool used last. M chooses it too.

data.name: ToolBrush
data.comment: The Brush group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: paints a ramp's characters. Key 1 chooses it while a brush is chosen.

data.name: ToolForegroundBrush
data.comment: The Brush group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: paints text colors. Key 2 chooses it while a brush is chosen.

data.name: ToolBackgroundBrush
data.comment: The Brush group's sub-toolbar and the Tools menu: paints backgrounds. Key 3 chooses it while a brush is chosen.

data.name: ToolGroupBrush
data.comment: Tools toolbar: the Brush group's button, which chooses the brush used last. B chooses it too.

data.name: AsciiOnlyConfirmMessageFormat

data.name: CanvasSizeUnit

data.name: CharacterSetAsciiOnlyOption
data.comment: New dialog: the document can hold only printable ASCII characters.

data.name: ResizeAnchorLabel

data.value: Cells outside the new size will be removed. You can undo this.

data.name: ResizeAnchorTopLeftSymbol

data.name: FontSourceBundledFormat
data.comment: {0} is a font family name.

data.value: This font's characters aren't all the same width, so some won't line up with the grid.

data.value: That file couldn't be loaded as a font.

data.name: FontAlreadyAvailableFormat
data.value: A font called {0} is already available, so that one is used.

data.name: UnexpectedErrorMessage

data.name: ActionShowFrameRate

data.comment: Debug menu: replaces the document with a busy one in colour, to check how the canvas draws colour.

data.comment: Debug menu: replaces the document with a small ANSI one, to check ANSI export in a terminal.

data.name: ActionOpenRgbTestSample
data.comment: Debug menu: the same sample in RGB, with rows of 24-bit colour.

data.name: ActionOpenDensitySample
data.comment: Debug menu: replaces the document with one listing its font's characters from lightest to darkest, to check glyph density.

data.name: RampStandard

data.name: RampStandardAlphanumerical
data.comment: Name of a built-in ramp of letters and digits.

data.name: RampFine
data.comment: Name of a built-in ramp: a long one, for smooth gradients.

data.name: RampBlocks
data.comment: Name of a built-in ramp of shade and block characters.

data.name: RampBraille
data.comment: Name of a built-in ramp of braille patterns.

data.name: SaveChangesMessageFormat
data.value: Do you want to save the changes to “{0}”?

data.name: OpenFailedNotADocumentFormat
data.value: “{0}” isn't a document this app can open.

data.value: “{0}” was saved by a newer version of this app (file format {1}). Update the app to open it.

data.name: OpenFailedDamagedFormat
data.value: “{0}” is damaged and can't be opened.

data.name: FontMissingMessageFormat
data.value: This document uses the font “{0}”, which isn't available on this computer. It's shown in {1} instead, and saving keeps “{0}” as its font.

data.name: ActionCopyAsText
data.comment: Copies the visible art to the clipboard as plain text.

data.name: ActionExportAsAnsi
data.comment: Writes the visible art to a .ans file, with the escape codes terminals use for colour.

data.name: ActionCopyAsAnsi
data.comment: Copies the visible art to the clipboard with the escape codes terminals use for colour.

data.name: ActionDeleteSelectedCells
data.comment: Edit menu: empties the selected cells of the active layer, taking away their characters, colours and backgrounds. The selection stays. Delete and Backspace on the canvas do the same, except while the Text tool's caret shows.

data.name: ActionSelectAll
data.comment: Select menu: selects every cell of the canvas.

data.name: ActionDeselect
data.comment: Select menu: selects nothing.

data.name: ActionInvertSelection
data.comment: Select menu: selects every cell that isn't selected, and none that is.

data.name: ActionGrowSelection
data.comment: Select menu: also selects every cell that touches the selection, along a side or at a corner.

data.name: ActionShrinkSelection
data.comment: Select menu: leaves out every selected cell that touches one that isn't, along a side or at a corner. Cells along the canvas's edges stay.

data.name: ActionSelectCellsWithGlyphs
data.comment: Select menu: selects the active layer's cells that hold a character other than a space, in place of the selection.

data.name: ActionSelectCellsWithBackground
data.comment: Select menu: selects the active layer's cells that have a background colour, in place of the selection.

data.name: ActionCloseWindow
data.comment: macOS only: closes the window and its document; the app keeps running.

data.name: ExportFailedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the file name, {1} the reason from the operating system.

data.name: ActionLayerNew
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: adds an empty layer above the active one.

data.name: ActionLayerDuplicate
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: copies the active layer.

data.name: ActionLayerDelete
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: deletes the active layer.

data.name: ActionLayerRename
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: opens the active layer's name for editing.

data.name: ActionLayerMoveUp
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: moves the active layer up the stack.

data.name: ActionLayerMoveDown
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: moves the active layer down the stack.

data.name: ActionLayerMergeDown
data.comment: Layer menu and Layers panel: merges the active layer into the one below.

data.name: LayerNameFormat
data.comment: A new layer's name. {0} is a number.

data.name: LayerCopyNameFormat
data.comment: A duplicated layer's name. {0} is the original's name.

data.name: LayerRowVisibleTip
data.comment: Tooltip on the checkbox that shows or hides a layer.

data.name: LayerRowLockedTip
data.comment: Tooltip on the checkbox that locks or unlocks a layer.

data.name: LayerRowSpacesTip
data.comment: Tooltip on the checkbox that makes a layer's spaces show the layers below.

data.name: ActionToggleLayers
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the Layers panel.

data.name: ActionToggleHistory
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the History panel.

data.name: ActionToggleFileToolbar
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with New, Open and Save.

data.name: ActionToggleToolsToolbar
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with the drawing tools.

data.name: ActionToggleEditToolbar
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with Undo, Redo and the document's settings.

data.name: ActionToggleViewToolbar
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with zoom and the grid.

data.name: ActionWindowFloat
data.comment: A widget's menu: takes the window off its side, to float on its own.

data.name: ActionWindowTurnIntoDock
data.comment: A widget's menu: turns the whole side into a dock.

data.name: ActionWindowTurnIntoWidget
data.comment: A floating window's menu: puts it on a side, as a widget.

data.name: ActionWindowClose
data.comment: A window's menu: closes it. The Window menu opens it again.

data.name: WindowMenuButtonTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the button in a window's title row that opens its menu.

data.name: WindowCloseButtonTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the button in a window's title row that closes it.

data.name: ActionToolbarHorizontal
data.comment: A toolbar's right-click menu: its buttons run left to right.

data.name: ActionToolbarVertical
data.comment: A toolbar's right-click menu: its buttons run top to bottom.

data.name: ActionToolbarHide
data.comment: A toolbar's right-click menu: hides the toolbar. The Window menu shows it again.

data.name: ActionResetLayout
data.comment: Window menu: puts every window and toolbar back where it started.

data.comment: History: an ellipse selected with Ellipse Select. Selecting doesn't make the document unsaved.

data.name: UndoStepLasso
data.comment: History: a shape selected with the Lasso.

data.comment: History: a shape selected with the Polygonal Lasso.

data.name: UndoStepMagicWand
data.comment: History: a selection made with the Magic Wand.

data.name: UndoStepInvertSelection
data.comment: History: Select, Invert.

data.comment: History: Select, Shrink by 1 Cell.

data.comment: History: Select, Select Cells with Glyphs.

data.name: UndoStepSelectCellsWithBackground
data.comment: History: Select, Select Cells with Background Color.

data.comment: History: emptying the selected cells with Edit, Delete or the Delete or Backspace key.

data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with the chosen tool's options, such as the brush size.

data.name: ActionToggleColorsToolbar
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the toolbar with the FG and BG colors.

data.name: ActionToggleColor
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the Color window, a colour picker.

data.name: ActionToggleSwatches
data.comment: Window menu: shows or hides the Swatches window, the 16 ANSI colours.

data.name: ActionColorModeMonochrome
data.comment: Document menu, a check mark item: the document holds no colours.

data.comment: Document menu, a check mark item: the document holds the 16 standard ANSI colours.

data.name: ActionColorModeRgb
data.comment: Document menu, a check mark item: the document holds any RGB colour.

data.name: ColorModeRemoveMessageFormat
data.value: Switching to monochrome removes the colors from {0:N0} cells. You can undo this.
data.comment: {0} is how many cells have a colour.

data.value: Switching to ANSI colors changes {0:N0} cells to the nearest of the 16 colors. You can undo this.

data.name: ColorModeLabel
data.comment: New dialog: the heading above the colour mode choices.

data.name: PaintColorNone
data.comment: Colors toolbar: the colour is none, so typing keeps the default text colour or the cell's own background.

data.name: PaintColorForegroundFormat
data.comment: Colors toolbar: {0} is the text colour's name, such as Red, #FF8800 or None.

data.name: PaintColorBackgroundFormat
data.comment: Colors toolbar: {0} is the background colour's name, such as Red, #FF8800 or None.

data.name: PaintColorTargetForeground
data.comment: Color and Swatches windows: which of the two colours they change.

data.name: PaintColorsNeedColorsNote
data.value: This document has no colors. Choose ANSI Colors or RGB Colors in the Document menu to use them.

data.name: ColorsToolbarForegroundLabel
data.comment: Colors toolbar: before the FG color's swatch.

data.name: ColorsToolbarBackgroundLabel
data.comment: Colors toolbar: before the BG color's swatch.

data.name: ColorsToolbarSwatchTipFormat
data.value: {0} Click to change it in the Color and Swatches windows. On the canvas, X swaps the two colors and D sets both to None (D is a temporary key).
data.comment: Colors toolbar: a swatch's tooltip. {0} is the color, such as "FG: Red".

data.name: ColorPanelNeedsRgbNote
data.value: The color picker is for RGB documents. Choose RGB Colors in the Document menu, or use the Swatches window.

data.name: SwatchNone
data.comment: Swatches window: sets the colour to none.

data.name: AnsiColorWhite
data.comment: The ANSI colour that most terminals show as light grey.

data.name: AnsiColorBrightBlack
data.comment: The ANSI colour that most terminals show as dark grey.

data.name: ToolOptionsNone
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: shown when the chosen tool has no options.

data.name: ToolOptionSelectionMode
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how a selection tool's shape combines with what's already selected. Shift, Alt (Option on a Mac) or both, held when a selection starts, pick a mode for that selection only.

data.name: ToolOptionSelectionModeReplace
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the shape becomes the selection.

data.name: ToolOptionSelectionModeAdd
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the shape is added to the selection. Shift picks it for one selection.

data.name: ToolOptionSelectionModeSubtract
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the shape is taken away from the selection. Alt (Option on a Mac) picks it for one selection.

data.name: ToolOptionSelectionModeIntersect
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: only the cells both the shape and the selection hold stay selected. Shift and Alt together pick it for one selection.

data.name: ToolOptionWandArea
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: whether the Magic Wand selects only the matching cells joined to the clicked one, or every matching cell.

data.name: ToolOptionWandContiguous
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects only the matching cells joined to the clicked one along their sides.

data.name: ToolOptionWandGlobal
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects every matching cell on the canvas.

data.name: ToolOptionWandSample
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: which layers the Magic Wand looks at to compare cells.

data.name: ToolOptionWandActiveLayer
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand compares the active layer's cells.

data.name: ToolOptionWandVisibleLayers
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand compares cells as the canvas shows every visible layer together.

data.name: ToolOptionWandMatch
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: what the Magic Wand compares cells by.

data.name: ToolOptionWandMatchGlyph
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects cells with the same character. A space and an empty cell count as the same. Tolerance does nothing here.

data.name: ToolOptionWandMatchLightness
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects cells whose character puts about as much ink on its cell, within the tolerance.

data.name: ToolOptionWandMatchTextColor
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects cells whose text colour is close, within the tolerance.

data.name: ToolOptionWandMatchBackgroundColor
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Magic Wand selects cells whose background colour is close, within the tolerance.

data.name: ToolOptionWandTolerance
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how far a cell may differ from the clicked one and still be selected. Dragging left or right while clicking with the Magic Wand changes it too.

data.name: ToolOptionSize
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the brush or eraser size, in cells.

data.name: ToolOptionShape
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the brush or eraser shape.

data.name: ToolOptionShapeSquare
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: a square brush shape.

data.name: ToolOptionShapeCircle
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: a round brush shape.

data.name: ToolOptionProportions
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: whether the brush's height counts cells or looks right on screen.

data.name: ToolOptionProportionsPerceptual
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the brush looks square or round on screen, so it's fewer cells tall than wide.

data.name: ToolOptionProportionsMathematical
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the brush is as many cells tall as wide, so a size 10 square is 10 by 10 cells.

data.name: ToolOptionPercentFormat
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: a percentage beside its slider. {0} is the number.

data.name: ToolOptionRamp
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: which ramp, from light to dark characters, the Brush paints with.

data.name: ToolOptionIntensity
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how dark the middle of the Brush paints, as a percentage.

data.name: ToolOptionSoftness
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how much of the Brush's or Soft Eraser's radius fades towards its edge, as a percentage.

data.name: ToolOptionStrength
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how far the Soft Eraser lightens the middle of its tip in one stroke, as a percentage. At 100% the middle empties.

data.name: ToolOptionBlendMode
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: how the Brush combines with what's already painted.

data.name: ToolOptionBlendModeBlend
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the Brush moves each cell towards its intensity.

data.name: ToolOptionBlendModeReplace
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: a blend mode still to come, shown greyed out.

data.name: ToolOptionBlendModeDarken
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: a blend mode still to come, shown greyed out.

data.value: This ramp needs a Unicode document
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the chosen ramp has characters an ASCII document can't hold, so the Brush won't paint and the Soft Eraser won't erase.

data.name: ToolWarningNoBackgrounds
data.value: This document has no background colours
data.comment: Tool Options toolbar: the BG Eraser is chosen in a monochrome document, so there's nothing for it to erase.

data.name: ActionToggleRamps

data.comment: Ramps window: adds a new ramp, a copy of Standard to start from.

data.name: ActionRampDuplicate
data.comment: Ramps window: adds a copy of the chosen ramp.

data.name: ActionRampDelete
data.comment: Ramps window: deletes the chosen ramp, after asking.

data.name: ActionRampSortByDarkness
data.comment: Ramps window: puts the chosen ramp's characters in order from lightest to darkest, as measured in the document's font.

data.name: ActionRampImport
data.comment: Ramps window: adds ramps from ramp files.

data.name: ActionRampExport
data.comment: Ramps window: saves the chosen ramp to a ramp file, to share it.

data.comment: Ramps window: the name a new ramp starts with. A number follows it when it's taken.

data.name: RampCopyNameFormat

data.name: RampPreviewLabel

data.name: ActionCharacterSetDuplicate
data.comment: Characters window: adds a copy of the chosen character set.

data.name: ActionCharacterSetDelete
data.comment: Characters window: deletes the chosen character set, after asking.

data.name: ActionCharacterSetImport
data.comment: Characters window: adds character sets from character set files.

data.name: ActionCharacterSetExport
data.comment: Characters window: saves the chosen character set to a file, to share it.

data.name: CharacterSetRecent
data.comment: Characters window: the set of the characters the Character Brush painted with last, newest first.

data.name: CharacterSetRecentEmpty
data.value: The characters you paint with show here.
data.comment: Characters window: shown while Recent is chosen and empty.

data.name: CharacterSetRecentNote
data.value: Recent can't be changed. Duplicate it to keep these characters as a set.
data.comment: Characters window: shown while Recent is chosen.

data.name: CharacterSetBuiltInNote
data.value: Built-in sets can't be changed. Duplicate one to edit a copy.
data.comment: Characters window: shown while a built-in set is chosen.

data.name: CharacterSetUnavailableNote
data.value: Greyed-out characters can't go in this document, which is ASCII only.
data.comment: Characters window: shown while some of the set's characters can't be painted in the document.

data.name: CharacterSetNameLabel
data.comment: Characters window: label of the chosen set's name.

data.name: CharacterSetCharactersLabel
data.comment: Characters window: label of the chosen set's characters, which can be typed or pasted.

data.name: CharacterSetNameBlank
data.comment: Characters window: the name being typed is empty, so the set keeps its old one.

data.name: CharacterSetNameTaken
data.value: Another set already has this name.
data.comment: Characters window: the name being typed is taken, so the set keeps its old one.

data.name: CharacterSetCharactersEmpty
data.comment: Characters window: there are no characters, so the set keeps its old ones, or Add can't make one.

data.name: CharacterSetCharactersUnusableFormat
data.value: U+{0} can't be in a set.
data.comment: Characters window: the characters being typed hold one that can't be painted, such as a tab. {0} is its code in hexadecimal.

data.name: CharacterSetNewLabel
data.comment: Characters window: label of the box where characters are typed or pasted to make a new set with Add.

data.name: CharacterSetAddButton
data.comment: Characters window: makes a new set of the characters typed in the box beside it, and chooses it.

data.name: CharacterSetNewName
data.comment: Characters window: the name a new set starts with. A number follows it when it's taken.

data.name: CharacterSetCopyNameFormat
data.comment: Characters window: the name of a duplicated set. {0} is the original's name.

data.name: CharacterTooltipFormat
data.comment: Characters window: the tooltip of a character. {0} is its code in hexadecimal.

data.name: DeleteCharacterSetTitle
data.comment: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting a character set.

data.name: DeleteCharacterSetMessageFormat
data.value: Delete the set “{0}”? This can't be undone.
data.comment: Asks before deleting a character set. {0} is its name.

data.name: DeleteCharacterSetConfirm
data.comment: The button that deletes the character set.

data.name: CharacterSetFileTypeName
data.comment: File picker: the kind of file a character set is shared in.

data.name: ImportCharacterSetsFilePickerTitle
data.comment: Title of the file picker for importing character sets.

data.name: ExportCharacterSetFilePickerTitle
data.comment: Title of the file picker for exporting a character set.

data.name: ImportCharacterSetsFailedTitle
data.comment: Title of the message saying some character set files couldn't be imported.

data.name: CharacterSetFileWrongKind
data.value: it isn't a character set file
data.comment: Why a file couldn't be imported.

data.name: ExportCharacterSetFailedTitle
data.comment: Title of the message saying a character set couldn't be exported.

data.name: ExportCharacterSetFailedMessageFormat
data.value: The set couldn't be saved as {0}. Check that the folder can be written to.
data.comment: {0} is the file's name.
